Activity: pausing over an oversized steamed dumpling lunch between event shifts; a closed food box and a small sand-filled hourglass sit beside her.
Outfit: an adult hourglass-keeper event costume in deep plum opaque cotton sateen: a folded fan-shaped halter bib with a supportive underbust band, rigid oval side-waist hoops joining it to fitted balloon shorts, and a short pleated rear bustle; bare shoulders, side waist and upper thighs, chest and pelvis securely covered. This is a theatrical event costume rather than armor or a real uniform.

Her own right upper arm runs visibly down from her right shoulder, her right elbow bent forward and her right hand holding one large dumpling near her mouth. Her own left upper arm drops at her left side, her left forearm resting across her raised knee and her left palm relaxed on that knee. Her torso leans slightly back, head turned gently toward the viewer. Late afternoon warm light with soft cheek shading.
